title: feat(fallk13): all-face-slide fails k=13 at the same 23 vs 41 as mu
science: FORCING NEGATIVE for the whole 2->2-clause direction: phi is strictly more expensive than mu on every non-corridor face slide, yet at k=13 on B_39 it returns the IDENTICAL pair 23 vs 41 (1587<1681). The optimal walk never uses a non-corridor 2->2 hop, so strengthening the corridor clause to all faces buys exactly zero -- the axis intercept stays +10 and the wall stays at k=13. The note records the coincidence but does not draw the structural conclusion.
